confirmed_boundaries: Mandatory principles cover M1-M12 and all submodule depths, including future nodes.
Shared plan consumers receive required read-only projections; compatible snapshots do not require equal object revision numbers.
External contract-compatible data can satisfy dependencies without running all upstream modules.
Parent-child proposal or delegation preserves a single authoritative field decision and commit path.
Submodule invocation and isolated checking do not require one standalone Skill or process per submodule.
Initial 41-submodule inventory is a design proposal, not implemented or tested capabilities.
M9/M7, M8/M12, and M2/M11 ownership boundaries remain intact.
Local checks can return with module outputs; M12 aggregates when global audit is needed.
Contract compatibility compares semantics and constraints, not literal equality of stochastic text.
Document checks do not certify runtime routing, H3 inference, or media quality.
resolved_items: Roadmap M8 summary now owns planned state and references independent M12 observations.
